capabilities: Sync vault files to a private GitHub repo
Commit and push changes automatically after a debounce
Pull the latest changes when Obsidian opens
Resolve conflicts in a side-by-side modal
Exclude files and folders by pattern
disambiguation: Not a general Git client for the vault; it only commits and pushes to a private GitHub repo to keep devices in sync.
extras: Free; each vault gets its own private repo (GitHub soft limit of 1 GB per repo). The GitHub token is stored only in the plugin's local data.json. README warns against running it alongside Obsidian Sync and includes full build-from-source and OAuth app setup instructions.
problem: Keeping a vault in sync across desktop and mobile without paying for a sync subscription or running a server.
summary: Plugin that syncs a vault across desktop and mobile through a private GitHub repository, committing on save and pulling on open.
